requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate recording of financial transactions to prevent data loss.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure data integrity.
The system shall maintain a unified audit trail of all transactions for 7 years.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage transaction processing faults.
The system shall ensure users can access essential functionalities during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to prevent inaccuracies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss.
The system shall process all financial transactions within 2 seconds.
The system shall support concurrent processing for at least 100 users.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations.
The system shall implement user access controls to restrict modifications to authorized personnel.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers.
The system shall implement two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall track the lifecycle resource impact of accounting features.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates.
